certificate: Rational infeasibility certificates for six types of odd prime order
statement: For each type, nonnegative multipliers y of the inequalities a.x <= b with y.A = 0 and y.b = -1, so the system has no rational solution (Proposition 3.3, reason 4; Appendix B.1.1).
scope: The finite systems and their certificates. That the systems encode the constraints on theta series is the argument of Appendix B.1.1.
